data.name: Olive Raiders
data.detailed_description:
Ride through a forgotten South, where revolvers clash with revolution. This is not the American West—this is post-unification Southern Italy, where fading nobles, ex-priests, bandits, and bounty hunters fight for power in a land torn between history and myth. In this Spaghetti Western-inspired narrative action game, you'll take on the role of Veronica, a Russian noblewoman who runs a casino in Naples and moonlights as a bounty hunter. Alongside her eccentric gang—including a pleasure-loving priest, a noble bored of wealth, and a seasoned brigand—you’ll choose contracts, face morally grey decisions, and uncover conspiracies that bind the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies to its ruins.

🎮 GAME FEATURES:

🔫 Cinematic Shootouts & Duels: Tactical third-person gunplay inspired by Spaghetti Western classics.

🎭 Multiple Playable Characters: Choose from Veronica, Aloisio the priest, Totonno the brigand, and Francesco the noble.

🌍 Historical-Fiction Setting: Explore stylized versions of Naples, Paestum, Salerno, and rural Southern villages reimagined as a lawless frontier.

🐴 Open-ended Missions: Work for Italians, Borbonics, or play both sides—your loyalties are yours to sell.

🎵 Original Soundtrack blending Morricone-esque cues with Southern Italian folk.

🗺️ Rich Dialogue & Choices: Interact with rebels, clergy, aristocrats, and outlaws through branching dialogue trees.

💥 Mini-games & Side Activities: From casino dancing to cannon testing, every location has its secrets.

Wishlist the full game now and saddle up for the revolution of the South.

Wishlist now and prepare for a frontier where the bullets sing in dialect and every truth wears a mask.
